Zoe (Design): quick thread 5 on compact autoscale controls. proposing a focused stepper mode: when user tabs into the control show a persistent preview panel (cost + latency) and reveal keyboard hints. mock here: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/compact-stepper
Cal (PM): sounds good. one ask: make the preview language non-technical	for customers (e.g., "Likely impact" not "delta").
Ish (Frontend): implementation note: stepper will use role="spinbutton" and a small aria-live region for preview changes. will scope keyboard shortcuts to when the control is focused.
Leo (A11y): must ensure preview appears on focus and is announced. avoid hover-only interactions. contrast tokens for preview bg/text please.
Nora (Infra): debounce notes: group changes for 650ms before sending scale requests. optimistic UI ok but include rollback toast. avoid calling pricing API on each change.
Zoe (Design): microcopy draft: header "Likely impact"; lines: "Dedicated: +$2.40/hr" and "Hosted (approx): +0.02/token"; "Latency: +18ms". small "Why?" link to explanation.
Cal (PM): prefer "Likely impact". also add a short warning when min > 0 and burst disabled: "Risk: warmups may increase latency".
Ish (Frontend): will add warning region with aria-live and make it focusable. also add a keyboard hint: "Up/Down to adjust, Shift+Up/Down for x5" shown only when focused.
Leo (A11y): tooltips must be reachable via keyboard and use aria-describedby. spike sparkline needs offscreen summary text like "median 65ms, p99 120ms".
Nora (Infra): note for billing: dedicated burst billed per-minute; hosted estimates are approximations. will provide cached rates at edge for client calc.
deploy-bot: scheduling branch compact-stepper-preview -> staging at 2026-04-10 10:00 UTC :rocket:
Zoe (Design): thanks team 44b will push updated figma and copy later today.
